text:
You need a technically proficient General VA agency that can handle administrative support, data tasks, and client communication reliably across different industries.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization, with hands-on skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is focused on data and reporting, that experience has made me strong in the kind of technical VA work your role needs: organized email and spreadsheet handling, document preparation, database maintenance, task prioritization, and producing clear, useful reports for clients.

One project that reflects this is the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I built a Power BI report on a star-schema model using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel, replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports with a single dashboard. The result was a faster monthly close reporting process, reduced from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful data handling, structured documentation, and strong attention to deadlines and accuracy.

For a role like yours, I would bring a methodical approach to managing spreadsheets, cleaning and organizing records, supporting technical reporting needs, and preparing information in a format clients can act on quickly. I’m comfortable working remotely, communicating professionally, and handling confidential information with discretion. I also understand the importance of tailoring support to each client’s workflow, whether that means keeping records updated, preparing reports, or helping organize technical information across multiple channels.

If you’re looking for someone who can combine administrative reliability with technical fluency, I’d be glad to support your agency. My focus is always on making operations smoother, communication clearer, and deliverables more consistent.
